data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Hello! This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app ('Settings' -> 'Security' -> 'Multi-Factor Authentication'). Once set up there, it will work for both web and mobile logins. [T-2252] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
